name: product-ui-illustrations
title_zh: 一套 UI 插画 SVG，功能描述丢进去就出图
tagline_zh: 给软件功能配图，不用再翻素材库碰运气。输入一句话或截图，输出极简抽象、风格统一的 SVG 插画，空状态、卡片。
tagline_en: Stop hunting for stock art. Feed it a feature or screenshot, get minimal abstract SVG illustrations—empty states.
desc_en: Generate minimal, abstract, UI-inspired illustrations for software product features — as deterministic SVG. Use when asked for a feature illustration, product illustration, spot illustration, empty-state graphic, feature-card artwork, docs or developer-portal illustration, or a consistent illustration set/family for a product. Also use to turn a feature description or a product screenshot into an
why_zh: 它把插画生成变成确定性流程：同一套视觉语言，批量产出不跑偏。适合要快速搭建设计系统配图。
why_en: Deterministic, not random: same visual language across every output. Built for teams that need cohesive product art fast.
limit_zh: 只认 SVG 输出，且风格限定极简抽象；不擅长写实或复杂场景。需要你提供清晰的功能描述或截图，否则可能生成不相关的图形。
limit_en: SVG only, minimal-abstract style; no photorealism or complex scenes. Needs clear feature text or screenshot, else output may miss the mark.
title_en: UI illustration SVG set from feature descriptions
